headline: Lam Research Stock Drops Despite In-Line Third-Quarter Sales
summary: Lam Research shares fell after the company reported third-quarter revenue figures that met expectations without positive surprises.
why: Lam Research manufactures wafer fabrication tools critical to semiconductor production. In-line results often disappoint investors when high valuation multiples demand earnings beats.

impacts.name: Lam Research Corporation
impacts.why: Shares slipped after quarterly sales matched forecasts rather than providing an upside surprise.

why_moved: The stock retreated because third-quarter revenue merely met expectations without offering the upside surprise investors sought.
